sources.scope: Selected fare/setup text only; general stroller and safety wording excluded

scenario.choice: Acquisition of two cards for the two older children, not all-family travel payment
scenario.basis: Researcher-defined desk task, not a real user or purchase

card_fees.currency_basis: ISO label interprets the primary pound symbol on London TfL pages
card_fees.unit: One newly acquired card; excludes travel credit

ordinary.purchase_surface: London station or other listed local outlet; no purchase attempted

child_setup.visitor_discount_basis: Half adult pay-as-you-go for the stated period; not an automatic card-purchase benefit
child_setup.qualifying_setup_places: Most Tube stations or Visitor Centres; no individual station or staff availability verified
child_setup.under_11_boundary: Published accompanied allowance covers up to four under11 children per fare-paying adult on specified rail modes; not every airport, river or rail product

desk_cases.assumption: No new cards are bought in this hypothetical case; zero acquisition is not evidence of valid reuse or free travel

failed_dependency.operation: web.click ordinary-card page linked Oyster entry
failed_dependency.affected_gate: Additional general PAYG/card-compatibility details not adopted; retained inspected fee pages remain scoped evidence
failed_dependency.unblock: Documented changed permitted access before this denied route is retried
failed_dependency.next_check: Changed access only; no alternate generic-PAYG source or tool to bypass403

decision.hypothesis: Buying ordinary Oyster instead of Visitor Oyster establishes a lower card-acquisition fee for the two older children
decision.result: REJECT lower published base-card fee; IMPLEMENT maintained acquisition comparison, PRESERVE full payment/eligibility decision unknown
decision.finding: Inspected base fees are equal. Postage, travel credit and child-discount application remain separate. An optional two-card component is not a mandatory all-family expense or a total saving.
decision.confidence: High inspected fee equality and integer-pence arithmetic; unknown exact-card eligibility, staff availability, complete travel costs and future operation
decision.next_gate: Applicable existing/ordinary-card discount terms through permitted evidence, actual party/payment/route/cap inputs and dated service; separate rendered/review/release gates before public integration
decision.next_falsification_trigger: Changed card fees or applicable discount/reuse terms; review before October31
decision.why_research_only: Existing173 public release still lacks actual rendered QA. This independent London cost-field audit resolves a different pending comparison without changing any public page.
